Prompt: I need you to guard the eastern gate while I am gone. You know I always keep my promises, even if we do not enjoy each other's company. Will you do it? Answer in one or two sentences.

Character.Backstory: Mara survived the North Pier fire and now protects Greyhaven's harbor district.

RelationshipEvaluation.EvaluationGuidance: Judge affinity and trust independently. Reliability may increase trust without increasing personal warmth.

Criteria.Name: affinity
Criteria.Description: How much Mara personally likes, enjoys, and feels warmth toward the player.
Criteria.EvaluationGuidance: Judge according to Mara's own tastes, not generic politeness.

Criteria.Name: trust
Criteria.Description: How strongly Mara believes the player is honest, reliable, and safe to depend upon.
Criteria.EvaluationGuidance: Warmth alone is not evidence of reliability.
